create_branch.description: Create a new branch in a GitLab project from an existing branch or commit.

parameters.name: project

parameters.description: The name for the new branch (for example, 'feature/login').
parameters.name: branch

update_merge_request.description: Change a merge request's title, description, target branch or labels, or close or reopen it. Only what you fill in changes.

parameters.description: The project to act on. Pick one from the list, or enter the project path shown in its web address (for example, 'my-group/my-project') or its numeric project ID.
parameters.name: project

parameters.description: The merge request to change. Pick one once you've chosen a project, or enter its number (for example, 3 for !3).
parameters.name: merge_request_iid

parameters.description: A new title for the merge request.
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: New main text, which replaces the old.
parameters.name: description

parameters.description: The branch it should merge into from now on.

parameters.description: Its labels from now on: these replace the ones it has. Leave empty to keep them.

merge_request.description: The merge request as it is now.

draft.description: Whether it's marked as a draft.

id.description: The merge request's ID across GitLab.

target_branch.description: The branch it would merge into.

description: Manage GitLab branches, issues, and merge requests with a personal access token, and start workflows on new issues and merge requests.

gitlab_issue_closed_trigger.description: Runs when an issue in a GitLab project is closed, with its title, labels and who closed it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.author: Who opened it (their username).
output.iid: The issue's number in its project (#5).
output.title: The issue's title.

parameters.description: The project to watch: its path from its web address, such as my-group/my-project, or its numeric project ID.
parameters.name: project

gitlab_merge_request_merged_trigger.description: Runs when a merge request in a GitLab project is merged, with its title, branches and who merged it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.author: Who opened it (their username).
output.draft: Whether it was marked as a draft.
output.id: The merge request's ID across GitLab.
output.title: Its title.

parameters.description: The project to watch: its path from its web address, such as my-group/my-project, or its numeric project ID.
parameters.name: project

gitlab_new_comment_trigger.description: Runs for each new comment in a GitLab project, on an issue, merge request or commit, with what it says and who wrote it. Comments already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.author: Who wrote it (their username).
output.commented_on: What it's on: issue, merge_request, commit or snippet.
output.number: The issue's or merge request's number in the project.
output.title: The title of the issue or merge request it's on.

parameters.description: The project to watch: its path from its web address, such as my-group/my-project, or its numeric project ID.
parameters.name: project

gitlab_new_commit_trigger.description: Runs for each new commit on a branch of a GitLab project, with its message and who wrote it. Commits already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.title: The first line of its message.

parameters.description: The project to watch: its path from its web address, such as my-group/my-project, or its numeric project ID.
parameters.name: project

parameters.description: The branch to watch, such as main. Leave blank for the project's default branch.
parameters.name: branch

gitlab_new_issue_trigger.description: Runs for each new issue in a GitLab project, with its title, text, labels and who opened it. Issues already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.author: Who opened it (their username).
output.iid: The issue's number in its project (#5).
output.title: The issue's title.

parameters.description: The project to watch: its path from its web address, such as my-group/my-project, or its numeric project ID.
parameters.name: project

gitlab_new_merge_request_trigger.description: Runs for each new merge request in a GitLab project, with its title, branches and who opened it. Merge requests already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.author: Who opened it (their username).
output.draft: Whether it's marked as a draft.
output.id: The merge request's ID across GitLab.
output.target_branch: The branch it would merge into.
output.title: Its title.

parameters.description: The project to watch: its path from its web address, such as my-group/my-project, or its numeric project ID.
parameters.name: project
